summary: Master the art of performance-based budgeting through our specialized training course. Achieve greater financial efficiency and accountability.
lede: Performance-based budgeting links spending plans to expected outputs, outcomes, and performance evidence. It is for budget officers, finance managers, and programme leaders who need to connect funding decisions with results by structuring programmes, costing activities, designing indicators, and interpreting expenditure and performance variances for budget submissions and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, challenge, approve, monitor, or communicate budgets linked to programme performance and organizational results.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in budgeting, financial planning, programme management, performance management, monitoring and evaluation, or management accounting. Familiarity with annual budget cycles and basic spreadsheet analysis is recommended. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted forecasting and dashboard design are taught at operational application level, while enterprise implementation is addressed through planning and roadmap exercises.
